name: Kirisaka Manami
source:
The youngest child of the Kirisaka family.

Kago Municipal Daiichi Junior High School 2nd year. Since she often returns home first, she usually has to wait for her older siblings. She is always overwhelmed by their constant bickering.

She is in the Broadcasting Committee Announcement Club, which is why she can always go home after 5pm.

[Translated from [url=https://d10rama.com/hitoyane/]official website[/url]]
